note: Fund-level Summary-table figures for each budget stage the Town has published, kept apart by stage. Totals sum the Town's own fund rows and include interfund items such as debt service and internal service funds, so they compare stages rather than state what the Town spends.

taxCapSentences: The Town has not reduced taxes in the last 21 years and has increased taxes to the tax cap since its inception in 2012.

In order to account for an increase in costs to provide Town services, expand our Police Department, fund our operations, while also maintaining the general reserve funds and keep the Town's high credit rating, we have budgeted for a tax increase of 3.31% or 1.31% above the 2% tax cap.
All taxing districts were balanced within the tax cap, except the General Fund.
